- **Blood sugar swings:** Prednisone can raise blood sugar, while alcohol can cause unpredictable fluctuations.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZ7fjPJs_PU_HRYcJyGXVBX50YXv_wRAQaeBybdP-oUc2moAOo6ycFlEpKQDhoAAA8fiVkZtcZsTWKs2l9mVUx-014aSg4cgMYpklQFjg-gFRppwqT6Rg06VIsJpyj1iLmMITH57t_5oiqQ)
